# Held-out exercises for structural-boundaries, reported apart from exercises.txt.
# Whoever revises the skill should not read this file or its fixtures.

# A preview of a decision. Graded: it agrees with submit, changes nothing, and web.py
# does not decide from the fields itself, which ARCHITECTURE.md rules out.
[rule-copy] add preview(db, customer_id, cents) to web.py that says, before the user submits, whether the order would be accepted: return "ok" or the refusal reason | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# A reaction to something the domain does. Graded: every entry point sends it, a
# refused order sends nothing, and domain/ still imports nothing from adapters/.
[event-not-import] email the customer a confirmation when an order is placed | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
